decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Karn Liberated to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also utilizing powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to close out the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to control the game early on and overwhelm the opponent with big threats in the late game.

This deck revolves around equipping creatures with Colossus Hammer and using Puresteel Paladin to keep the equipment flowing. Sigarda's Aid allows for instant equip abilities, while Stoneforge Mystic tutors for needed pieces. Inkmoth Nexus can be used as an alternate win condition by turning into an infect creature. The deck includes protection with Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce, and has some card draw with Esper Sentinel. Urza's Saga helps to tutor for key artifacts, while Kemba, Kha Enduring can provide more creatures for equipping. The Reality Chip can provide a small boost when needed.

The focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. With a selection of efficient removal spells and hand disruption cards, along with powerful threats like Tarmogoyf and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional value and flexibility to the deck's strategy. Overall, this deck excels at maintaining a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's plans.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents with cascade spells to overwhelm them before they can stabilize. The key strategy is to cast cascade spells like Violent Outburst or Shardless Agent to generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent while using counterspells like Force of Negation to protect your board. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Dead / Gone and powerful creatures like Brazen Borrower and Seasoned Pyromancer to maintain board control and close out the game quickly.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, supported by efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Counterspell and Spell Snare to control the game tempo. Expressive Iteration helps dig for more threats, while Mishra's Bauble provides card advantage and deck manipulation. The mana base includes fetch lands to ensure smooth color fixing and Seasoned Pyromancer and Brazen Borrower offer versatile threats to pressure opponents. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Boseiju, Who Endures early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Transmogrify and Leyline Binding to further enable the combo aspect of the deck. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to surprise the opponent with unexpected plays and overwhelming board presence, combining different elements to create a unique and powerful strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful control elements such as counterspells, removal, and planeswalkers to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Solitude and Omnath, Locus of Creation to pressure the opponent and quickly close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana needed to cast the diverse range of spells in the deck. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of disruption, card advantage, and powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to leverage the powerful synergy between Underworld Breach and various cards that can be played from the graveyard or have delve mechanics. By constantly recycling cards from the graveyard, the deck aims to generate a significant advantage and overwhelm the opponent with a rapid and consistent stream of threats and disruption. In addition, the inclusion of Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer adds a proactive element to the deck, allowing for early aggression and additional card advantage.

This deck revolves around utilizing the card Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Dwarven Mine tokens onto the battlefield. The combo potential is further enhanced with cards like Persist and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Thoughtseize and Wrenn and Six provide disruption and card advantage to keep the combo going smoothly. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to control the board. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to creatively assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with efficient combos.

The deck focuses on utilizing the card Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and persist, while also using Wrenn and Six to recur lands and generate value. Teferi, Time Raveler helps protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck also includes cards like Prismari Command and Leyline Binding for additional utility and disruption. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize the potential of Dwarven Mine. Overall, the deck aims to create explosive plays and overwhelm opponents with its combo potential and versatility.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures and burn spells to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. By utilizing a variety of colored lands and spells, it aims to maximize its damage output and disruption potential. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional element of consistency and versatility to the deck. This Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using human creatures. By utilizing Aether Vial to cheat creatures into play and cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Thalia's Lieutenant to buff up the team, the deck aims to quickly build a formidable board presence. Cards like Meddling Mage and Ranger-Captain of Eos provide disruptive elements to control the opponent's game plan. The mana base including Cavern of Souls and Unclaimed Territory ensures consistent mana production for casting the aggressive human creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful cards with the Cascade mechanic to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to cheat out big threats like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation and removal spells like Dead / Gone. The mana base is tailored to support the diverse color requirements of the deck, allowing for consistency in casting spells and maintaining pressure on the opponent.

The deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing efficient removal and discard spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to apply pressure and close out the game. The inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief further disrupts the opponent's strategy by stripping away key cards from their hand or graveyard. The deck also utilizes cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its key threats and ensure a consistent aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to equip it for a quick and lethal attack with keywords such as infect and double strike. The deck also utilizes Stoneforge Mystic to tutor for key pieces, while utilizing cards like Sigarda's Aid to cheat equipment into play. The presence of protection cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce help protect the combo from disruption, making it a fast and resilient strategy in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Leyline Binding, while using Teferi, Time Raveler to protect the combo and disrupt opponent's plays. It also includes cards like Dwarven Mine and Wrenn and Six to generate tokens and ramp up mana. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures, utilizing efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismatic Ending to control the game.
